model: Broker FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (bank-style, net debt held at zero, engine route), earnings retention for net-capital growth as the reinvestment charge, perpetual-bond distributions charged in the flow

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue and other income (IFRS gross basis: fee and commission + interest income + net investment gains + other), RMB m. H1 2026 actual 31,306 (+49% YoY, interim income statement) + H2 2026E ~27,200 (H2 2025 actual = 47,220 - 20,979 = 26,240, held near flat; the H1 2026 trading-volume rally is NOT extrapolated into H2). FY2025 actual 47,220; FY2024 54,285 as reported (46,338 restated ex-AssetMark, which was sold to GTCR in Sept 2024); FY2023 52,260; FY2021 48,338 (prior cycle peak). No Q3 2026 report is in the folder yet (due late Oct 2026) - the first evidence that would move this anchor.
inputs.share_count_basis: 9,026,863,786 A + H ordinary shares at 30 Jun 2026 (interim line 1031, unchanged from 31 Dec 2025). Diluted weighted average 9,022.5m vs basic 9,021.8m at FY2025 (AR line 25937) - dilution from restricted A shares is immaterial, so the period-end count is used. One class with identical economic rights, so the per-share value applies to the H share. Held FLAT: SBC has run to zero (restricted-share scheme lapsed; FY2025 RMB5.1m, H1 2026 nil), no options or convertibles; ShareRepurchases nil since the FY2021 RMB49m buyback.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Securities firm: bonds payable, short-term debt instruments, repo obligations, placements and borrowings (core_metrics total_debt RMB291.8bn at 30 Jun 2026; 265.2bn at FY2025) fund the margin-financing book, the proprietary and market-making books and client-driven products - operating funding of a leveraged financial intermediary (total assets ~RMB1.08tn), not a claim to subtract from an equity flow. Cash (RMB59.7bn own cash at 30 Jun 2026) is working liquidity; brokerage-client payables are matched by segregated client deposits. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route (house convention: 6099.HK, 1788.HK, 2016.HK, 0998.HK) and nothing is bridged after the flows. Gross figures are retained in core_metrics for the reader.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE (dividend capacity under the model's retention convention), not reported OCF - capex: FY2026E PBT ~24,100 (H1 actual 13,772 + H2E ~10,300; H2 2025 was 9,880) x (1 - 14% income tax) = ~20,700, less perpetual-bond distributions ~1,000 = ~19,700 to ORDINARY shareholders, less 58% retained (~11,400) to grow net capital = ~8,270. Actual FY2026 cash dividends will be lower (~RMB5.6bn: interim RMB0.18/share paid + final ~0.44/share expected). reported_fcf is FY2025 reported OCF - capex (-63,456 - 1,222 = -64,678); reported OCF swings from +70bn (FY2022) to -65bn (FY2021) and -63bn (FY2025) with margin-loan, repo and trading-book balances and is NOT an earnings proxy, so the owner-FCF identity (reported - SBC - interest income) is deliberately not applied on this route.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR note 63 line 25156: share-based payment expense RMB5,094k (FY2024 101,204k; FY2023 187,494k; FY2020 peak 654,134k) - the 2018 restricted A-share incentive scheme has fully vested/lapsed and H1 2026 shows nil (interim line 12415). Treated as SBC-zero going forward: sbc_pct_path 0. Interest income (RMB13.9bn FY2025) is operating revenue of a broker (margin financing, treasury) and is NOT stripped - there is no net cash added back. House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate (band collapsed).
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Company reports in RMB thousands) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1748 on Yahoo Finance at 2026-10-23T17:16Z. Parity check: the A share (601688.SS) closed CNY 17.25 on 2026-10-23 = HKD 20.27 at this rate, so the H share at HKD 15.19 trades at a 25% AH discount - normal for large Chinese brokers (6099.HK showed a similar gap). The LSE GDR (HTSC.L, 1 GDR = 10 A shares) last printed on Yahoo in July 2024 and is not a usable parity anchor. Per-share values in this file are CNY; the engine emits the HKD twin and the canonical weighted_iv in HKD.
inputs.ordinary_book_note: Equity attributable to owners RMB216,144.8m at 30 Jun 2026 less other equity instruments (perpetual subordinated bonds) RMB37,300m = RMB178,844.8m ordinary book = RMB19.81/share = HKD23.27/share; price HKD15.19 = 0.65x ordinary book (A share 0.87x). FY2025 ordinary book per share RMB19.24 per AR line 16109. Ordinary ROE: FY2025 15,587 / avg ordinary equity ~168.5bn = 9.3%; FY2026E ~19,700 / ~181bn = ~10.9% at the cycle high; FY2022-24 average ~8%.
inputs.perpetual_treatment: RMB37.3bn perpetual subordinated bonds sit in equity (other equity instruments: 28.3bn FY2024, 33.3bn FY2025, 37.3bn 30 Jun 2026; AR line 5125, interim line 4226). Their distributions are charged in equity, not in the income statement: FY2025 net profit 16,383.5 less profit to ordinary shareholders 15,587.1 = ~RMB796m (FY2024 ~716m). The model treats them as debt-like and charges the coupon in the flow (~RMB1.05bn/yr on the larger 37.3bn face, folded into cash_tax_rate_path), with the face left outstanding - consistent with how debt interest sits inside a broker's PBT. ALTERNATIVE (face deducted at par after the flows): equity value lower by RMB37,300m = RMB4.13/share = HKD4.85/share, which would take the base case to roughly 0.45x ordinary book; not adopted because the instruments are callable-and-rollable regulatory capital funding earning assets inside PBT, and deducting face while also charging the coupon would double-count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 11.0% in CNY, the discount rate for an FCFE flow (no debt in the bridge, so no WACC blend). Build: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% + China ERP ~6.5% x beta ~1.3 (A/H broker betas 1.2-1.4 on ~5x nominal leverage, earnings tied to A-share turnover) = ~10.3%, plus ~0.7pt for H-share minority/governance and policy risk at a Jiangsu-SASAC-controlled SOE = 11.0%. Matched to 6099.HK (11.0%, peer broker) and 2016.HK (11.0%) for cross-ticker comparability; Huatai's BBB+ rating and larger scale argue for no premium above those. Same rate in all three scenarios - risk is carried by the scenario paths and weights, not by per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: Immaterial: lease liabilities RMB410m at FY2025 (AR line 29408) against RMB1.08tn of assets; ROU depreciation and lease interest sit inside segment expenses, i.e. inside the pre-tax margin used as the ebitda_margin_path. No separate lease line, no lease liability in net debt (which is zero on this route). lease_cost_pct_path is 0.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests RMB69m at 30 Jun 2026 (0.03% of equity; the 3.1bn FY2023 balance was AssetMark's minority, gone with the 2024 sale). FY2025 NCI share of profit was -RMB10.7m, H1 2026 +10.4m. Attributable flows are used (PBT x (1 - tax)) and nothing is bridged; the rounding is well inside the tax-rate assumption.
inputs.notes: MODEL: broker FCFE capitalised at cost of equity, run through the Drivers/engine route (net_debt = 0, CoE as 'wacc'), NOT an owner-FCF DCF: a securities firm's reported OCF is dominated by swings in margin loans, repos and trading inventories (-63bn FY2025, +70bn FY2022) and its bonds/repos are operating funding, so FCF - net debt would be meaningless. dcf-methods SKILL.md has no explicit broker row; the bank/financial principle applies (discount the flow to equity holders at the cost of equity, never subtract funding liabilities). Encoding: ebitda_margin_path = pre-tax profit margin (PBT / total revenue and other income); da_pct_path = 0; capex_pct_path = earnings retained to grow regulatory net capital and the balance sheet, as % of revenue (the reinvestment charge); cash_tax_rate_path = income tax + perpetual-bond distributions as % of PBT; wc_capture 0; sbc 0. Precedents in memory: 6099.HK (China Merchants Securities, identical encoding), 1788.HK, 2016.HK, 0998.HK. First valuation of this ticker - no prior DCF, no reconciliation block. FY2024 comparatives: reported net profit 15,351m included the AssetMark disposal gain (~USD796m) and a net income tax CREDIT of 166m; FY2024 is excluded as a margin or tax base. Cyclical position: the valuation is struck at a cyclical earnings high (H1 2026 attributable profit +55% YoY, pre-tax margin 44%); FY2027 revenue is reset below FY2026E in base and bear, and the H1 2026 run-rate is extrapolated only in the bull case.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (FY2020-FY2025, 39,581 -> 47,220) - the only series not inflated by the FY2025 market upcycle base effect; the forward base path averages ~2.5%/yr over 10 years from an FY2026E peak
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 9.9% is 2.7x the revenue 5yr CAGR of 3.6%: book compounds through ~68% earnings retention plus RMB37bn of perpetual issuance while revenue grows with the market cycle, so ordinary ROE has compressed from ~10% (FY2020-21) to ~8% (FY2022-24) before the FY2025-26 rebound. Equity CAGR is a capital-accumulation rate here, not a growth rate shareholders are paid for - it is why the model charges retention explicitly.
historical_growth.notes: fcf CAGRs are computed on profit attributable to ORDINARY shareholders (net profit less perpetual distributions: FY2020 10,822 [no perpetuals then], FY2022 11,053, FY2025 15,587), the FCFE base on this route, not on reported OCF - capex (which is -64.7bn in FY2025 and +33.0bn in FY2024 and carries no information about earnings). EPS CAGRs use RMB EPS 1.20 (FY2020) / 1.18 (FY2022) -> 1.73 (FY2025). FY2025 is a strong-market year, so the 3-year figures overstate trend; FY2017 peak-to-FY2025 revenue CAGR is 6.0% and net profit 7.4%.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 -8% to ~RMB53.8bn: A-share/HK turnover and net investment gains ease from the H1 2026 peak (attributable profit +55% YoY) toward the FY2025 level on a larger margin and trading book; still +14% on FY2025 because ADT, margin balances (RMB7.8bn margin interest FY2025) and the international platform (H1 2026 segment PBT RMB3.2bn) are structurally larger. Then +2% as the cycle settles, +4% through the mid-years (wealth-management AUM migration from deposits/property, fund advisory, pension finance, international build-out) fading to 3% nominal - in line with the 5-year revenue CAGR of 3.6% and below the FY2017-25 CAGR of 6.0%.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin (PBT / total revenue and other income): FY2021 33.7%, FY2022 26.1%, FY2023 27.2%, FY2024 28.3% as reported (33.1% on the restated ex-AssetMark revenue), FY2025 39.0%, FY2026E ~41% (H1 44.0%). Base resets to 36.5% in FY2027 and holds 36% - above the FY2021-24 average (~30%) because AssetMark's low-margin consolidated revenue is gone and the mix has shifted toward investment, interest and institutional income, but below FY2025-26 because the fixed cost base (branches, ~RMB4bn+ funding cost, AI/technology spend) does not shrink with turnover.
base.capex_rationale: Earnings retained to grow net capital and the balance sheet, as % of revenue. FY2027 17.0% = 58% of ordinary profit (ordinary margin 36.5% x (1 - 19.5%) = 29.4% of revenue; actual FY2023-25 retention 68-69%: FY2025 dividends RMB0.55 x 9,027m = 4.97bn on ordinary profit 15,587 = 32% payout), gliding to 10.4% = 36% of ordinary profit (29.0% of revenue) at terminal = g 3.0% / terminal ordinary ROE ~8.5%. Payout rising toward ~64% reflects CSRC's dividend push, Huatai's own rising DPS (0.43 -> 0.52 -> 0.55; interim 0.15 -> 0.18) and a slower-growing balance sheet freeing capital. FY2027 FCFE ~RMB6.7bn vs an expected ~RMB5.5-6bn ordinary dividend.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~14% of PBT (FY2025 11.0%, H1 2026 15.0%, FY2023 8.2%; FY2024's net credit excluded; structurally below the 25% statutory rate because fund dividends and government/local bond interest are tax-exempt - RMB2.25bn tax effect of non-taxable income in FY2025, AR line 25397) + NCI ~0% + perpetual-bond distributions ~RMB1.05bn on RMB37.3bn (~5.3% of a ~RMB19.6bn FY2027 PBT) = ~19.5%. Held flat: the coupon's share of PBT falls as PBT grows, but perpetual issuance has grown every year (ignored, conservative).
base.terminal_note: Gordon on FY2036 FCFE at 11.0% - 3.0% = 12.9x; the 15x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.7x on ~8.5% ordinary ROE, consistent with (ROE - g) / (CoE - g).
base.narrative: Cycle normalises, franchise intact: revenue resets 8% below the FY2026E peak, pre-tax margin settles at 36%, the balance sheet grows 3-4% a year on retained earnings and the payout drifts up toward two-thirds. Terminal ROE ~8.5% against an 11% cost of equity, so the business is worth less than book.

bull.growth_rationale: The China capital-markets upcycle runs: record A-share turnover and doubled Stock Connect flows persist through FY2027 (+2% on the FY2026E peak rather than a reset), household wealth keeps reallocating from deposits and property into funds and ETFs, the international platform (GTP across HK/NY/London/Singapore, NYSE lead-underwriter status) compounds, and CSRC's 'first-class investment bank by 2035' programme favours the top-5 incumbents. Mid-years 5-6% then 3.5% nominal.
bull.margin_rationale: FY2025's 39% is held as the new normal: AI-driven cost take-out (AI ZhangLe, intelligent research, GTP) plus mix shift to institutional/investment income offset commission-rate pressure. Still below the H1 2026 44%.
bull.capex_rationale: Retention 50% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (ordinary margin 39% x (1 - 19%) = 31.6% of revenue) gliding to 33% at terminal (30.8% of revenue x 33% = 10.1%) = g 3.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~10.5%; higher ROE needs less retention per unit of growth and CSRC's payout push is met in full.
bull.tax_rationale: Income tax ~14.5% + perpetual distributions ~4.5% of a larger PBT = 19.0%.
bull.terminal_note: Gordon at 11.0% - 3.5% = 13.8x; 15x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.9x on ~10.5% ROE.
bull.narrative: Upcycle sustained and consolidation winner: Huatai holds a 38-39% pre-tax margin on a revenue base that keeps growing from the FY2026E level, ROE returns to double digits, and payout rises to two-thirds. Even here terminal ROE is only ~10.5% against an 11% cost of equity - the bull case is a near-book outcome, not a re-rating story.

bear.growth_rationale: Turnover-driven bust: A-share ADT halves from the 2026 peak (as in 2022-23 after the 2021 peak, and as Q3 2025 showed with revenue -7%/profit -28% YoY inside a single soft quarter), investment gains turn to marks against the proprietary book, IPO/refinancing issuance stays rationed, and declining Chinese rates compress margin-financing and treasury yields. FY2027 revenue ~RMB45.6bn, back to the FY2025 level; flat FY2028, then 2-3% nominal as the merged CICC-Dongxing-Cinda, Guotai Haitong and Orient-Shanghai groups take share.
bear.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin back to the FY2021-24 band (26-34%, average ~30%): operating leverage works in reverse on the fixed cost base, credit losses on the margin/pledge book and property-linked bond exposures recur, and commission undercutting resumes in a consolidating industry.
bear.capex_rationale: Retention stays high: 65% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (ordinary margin 31% x (1 - 20%) = 24.8% of revenue) as management holds the ~32% payout and keeps building net capital through the downturn, easing to 41% at terminal (25.6% of revenue x 41% = 10.5%) = g 2.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~6%. Sub-CoE ROE on a growing book is the value-destruction mechanism in this case.
bear.tax_rationale: Income tax ~13% + perpetual distributions ~7% of a smaller (~RMB14bn) PBT = 20%.
bear.terminal_note: Gordon at 11.0% - 2.5% = 12.1x; 15x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.45x on ~6% ROE - where small Chinese brokers' H shares have traded in past troughs.
bear.narrative: Cyclical bust plus structural share loss: revenue falls back to the FY2025 level and stays there in real terms, margins revert to the 2021-24 band, and a low payout keeps piling retained capital onto a ~6% ROE. The balance sheet remains sound (risk coverage well above requirements, BBB+ rating) so this is an earnings-power case, not a solvency case.

scenario_narratives.base: Cycle normalises, franchise intact. FY2027 revenue resets 8% below the FY2026E peak as A-share/HK turnover and investment gains ease, then grows 2-4% a year on wealth-management AUM migration, margin financing and the international platform. Pre-tax margin settles at 36% (above the pre-AssetMark-sale 30% average, below the 2025-26 peak). Retention falls from 58% toward 36% of ordinary profit as CSRC's payout push and a slower-growing book free capital. Terminal ordinary ROE ~8.5% against an 11% CNY cost of equity: the business is worth roughly two-thirds of ordinary book, which is where the H share already trades.
scenario_narratives.bull: Upcycle sustained and consolidation winner. Record turnover and Stock Connect flows persist, household savings keep moving into capital-markets products, AI-driven cost take-out holds the pre-tax margin at 38-39%, and Huatai's top-tier scale, BBB+ rating and GTP international footprint make it a beneficiary of the CSRC's 2-3 'first-class investment banks' programme. ROE returns to double digits and payout rises to two-thirds. The axes are turnover persistence and margin retention; even then terminal ROE (~10.5%) only just reaches the cost of equity, so this is a near-book outcome.
scenario_narratives.bear: Turnover bust plus structural share loss. ADT halves from the 2026 peak, proprietary marks turn negative, issuance stays rationed and declining Chinese rates compress margin-financing yields; FY2027 revenue falls 22% to the FY2025 level and margins revert to the 2021-24 band (~31-32%). Merged rivals (CICC-Dongxing-Cinda, Guotai Haitong, Orient-Shanghai) take share and reignite commission undercutting. Management holds the ~32% payout, so retained capital keeps compounding onto a ~6% ROE. Solvency is not at issue; earnings power and capital discipline are.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% house default, matching the 30% used for peer broker 6099.HK and below the 35-40% used for thin-capital Chinese banks): the valuation is struck at a cyclical earnings high (H1 2026 attributable profit +55% YoY, pre-tax margin 44%, A-share turnover at records), the Q3 2025 print showed how fast earnings fall when turnover softens, and state-directed consolidation has produced larger rivals; but capital is ample (net capital ~RMB100bn, BBB+ the highest among Chinese brokers), there is no solvency or capital-raise dimension, and the franchise (top-5 by assets and profit, #1-3 in margin lending, derivatives, ABS) is intact. Bull 20%: the China upcycle could run and Huatai is one of the few credible consolidators, but sustaining a 38-39% margin on a growing base requires the market to hold its gains, and even the bull case barely earns its cost of equity. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Huatai is a scale leader in a commoditised, policy-steered, highly cyclical industry whose earnings track A-share turnover. It is valued as a stream of distributable profit to ordinary shareholders at an 11% CNY cost of equity, with the capital that must be retained to grow regulatory net capital charged explicitly and the perpetual-bond coupons deducted. Because ordinary ROE (~8-9% through the cycle, ~11% at the 2026 peak) sits below the cost of equity, the business is worth less than its RMB19.81/share (HKD23.27) ordinary book, and the H share's 0.65x P/B is close to fair rather than cheap. The valuation does not extrapolate the H1 2026 run-rate; the bull case does, and still lands near book. Upside would need a durable step-up in ROE (payout above 60% with margins held near 39%) or a lower cost of equity for Chinese financials - neither is in the base case.
key_risks_to_valuation: Turnover cyclicality: a 2022-23-style bust in A-share ADT takes FY2027 revenue down 20%+ and pre-tax margin back to ~30% (bear case); the Q3 2025 print (-28% profit YoY) shows the speed of the move

Retention/payout policy: the model assumes payout rises from ~32% toward ~64%; if Huatai keeps retaining two-thirds of profit on a sub-CoE ROE, FCFE stays near the current ~RMB5-6bn dividend and value sits closer to the bear case

Perpetual capital: RMB37.3bn of perpetuals are charged via coupon, not deducted at face; deducting face would remove HKD4.85/share. Continued issuance (5bn/yr recently) raises the fixed charge ahead of ordinary shareholders

Policy and regulatory risk: commission-rate caps, net-capital rules, Stock Connect access and CSRC consolidation directives can move revenue, capital needs and competitive structure with little company control; a state-directed merger could also change the share count
Proprietary-book and credit risk: equity, FICC and derivatives marks and margin/pledge-book credit losses can swing a year's PBT by several billion RMB; property-sector bond exposure persists
Currency: value is built in CNY and quoted in HKD; a 5% CNY move against HKD is a 5% move in the HKD values
AH structure: the H share trades at a 25% discount to the A share; the model values the economic share, and the discount can widen or narrow independently of fundamentals

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (6886.HK, HKD; 52-week range 14.72-21.80); CNYHKD=X and 601688.SS from the same API for the fx bridge and AH parity check
data_sources.financials: 6886.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2017-H1 FY2026, RMB), from 6886.HK_Annual_FY2018-FY2025.txt, 6886.HK_HalfYear_H1-2024/2025/2026.txt and the Q1/Q3 quarterly reports; PBT, tax, D&A, NCI, perpetual-bond balances, dividends and share counts read off the FY2025 annual report and the H1 2026 interim report (file:line pointers in inputs notes)
data_sources.qualitative: 6886.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): AssetMark divestiture, cyclicality, consolidation wave, AI/GTP strategy, dividend record; FY2025 annual report CEO letter and 'Outlook for 2026' sections
